question: The book authored by Vijay Lokapally on Virat Kohli in the year 2023 is ____________________.

options.text: The Cover Shot: The Virat Kohli Story (Revised and Updated World Cup Edition)
The Straight Drive: The Virat Kohli Story (Revised and Updated World Cup Edition)
Driven: The Virat Kohli Story (Revised and Updated World Cup Edition)
The Cover Drive: The Virat Kohli Story (Revised and Updated World Cup Edition)

solution:
The correct answer is__** Driven: The Virat Kohli Story (Revised and Updated World Cup Edition)**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The book authored by **Vijay Lokapally** in **2023** on **Virat Kohli** is titled:
 
• **"Driven: The Virat Kohli Story (Revised and Updated World Cup Edition)."**
 
• This revised edition of the book highlights Virat Kohli's remarkable journey in cricket and includes:
 
• **It **Focuses on Kohli's performances in the **World Cup** and other recent milestones.
 
• **It **Features updated visuals of key moments in Kohli's career.
 
• **It **Provides insights into his achievements in the cricketing world.
 
• The **book originally explores Kohli's life, his growth as a cricketer, and the passion and determination that made him one of India's greatest sports icons**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Virat Kohli is an Indian cricketer and the former captain of the Indian national team.
 
• A right-handed top-order batsman, Kohli is regarded as one of the best contemporary batsmen in the world.
 
• He plays for Royal Challengers Bangalore in the Indian Premier League (IPL) and has been the team's captain since 2013.

 
• Kohli was appointed the vice-captain of the ODI team in 2012 and handed over the Test captaincy following Mahendra Singh Dhoni's Test retirement in 2014.
 
• In early 2017, he became the limited-overs captain as well after Dhoni stepped down from the position. In ODIs, Kohli has the second-highest number of centuries and the highest number of centuries in run-chases in the world.
 
• He holds the world record for being the fastest batsman to 8,000, 9,000, 10,000, and 11,000 runs in ODI cricket, reaching the milestones in 175, 194, 205, and 222 innings respectively.
